sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.StoreCode AS storeCode, p.StoreName AS name, p.PortalId AS portalId, MIN(d.DomainName) AS domainName, MIN(CASE WHEN d.DomainName NOT LIKE @builderDomainPattern THEN d.DomainName END) AS webstoreDomain FROM dbo.ZnodePortal p LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeDomain d ON d.PortalId = p.PortalId WHERE d.ApplicationType = @applicationType AND d.IsActive = @domainActive AND (@store IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @store) AND (@exceptPortalId IS NULL OR p.PortalId <> @exceptPortalId) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.StoreCode = @preferred) GROUP BY p.PortalId, p.StoreCode, p.StoreName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.DomainId) >= @minWebstoreDomains ORDER BY p.PortalId
